recordings.title: Gain in the app
recordings.description: Gain changes from 0 to -60 dB at 3.2 seconds. More negative values make it quieter. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Volume in the app
recordings.description: Volume changes from 100 to 0 % at 3.2 seconds. 0% silences this output. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Bass in the app
recordings.description: Bass changes from 0 to -12 dB at 3.2 seconds. Cuts low frequencies. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: 31.5 Hz in the app
recordings.description: 31.5 Hz changes from 0 to -18 dB at 3.2 seconds. Cut a little to reduce floor, handling or mechanical rumble. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Frequency · band 1 in the app
recordings.description: Frequency · band 1 changes from 1000 to 20 Hz at 3.2 seconds. Moves it toward lower-pitched content. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Threshold in the app
recordings.description: Threshold changes from -18 to -60 dBFS at 3.2 seconds. Lower values compress more of the signal. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Threshold in the app
recordings.description: Threshold changes from -45 to -80 dBFS at 3.2 seconds. Opens for quieter sound and potentially room noise. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Ceiling in the app
recordings.description: Ceiling changes from -1 to -12 dBFS at 3.2 seconds. Leaves more headroom. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Delay in the app
recordings.description: Delay changes from 0 to 1000 ms at 3.2 seconds. Moves sound later. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Semitones in the app
recordings.description: Semitones changes from 0 to -12 semitones at 3.2 seconds. Lowers pitch. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Mains frequency in the app
recordings.description: Mains frequency changes from 60 to 45 Hz at 3.2 seconds. Moves the series lower. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Threshold in the app
recordings.description: Threshold changes from 50 to 0 % at 3.2 seconds. Detects more subtle clicks. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Reduction in the app
recordings.description: Reduction changes from 70 to 0 % at 3.2 seconds. Retains more original sound. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Strength in the app
recordings.description: Strength changes from 70 to 0 % at 3.2 seconds. Retains more of the original signal. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Threshold above noise in the app
recordings.description: Threshold above noise changes from 3 to -20 dB at 3.2 seconds. Lets more frequency regions pass. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Wet mix in the app
recordings.description: Wet mix changes from 100 to 0 % at 3.2 seconds. Includes more dry sound. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Muted in the app
recordings.description: Muted changes from false to true at 3.2 seconds. Silences the branch passing through this node. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Active input in the app
recordings.description: Active input changes from a to b at 3.2 seconds. Which explicitly wired port is heard. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Active output in the app
recordings.description: Active output changes from a to b at 3.2 seconds. Which output port receives audio. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues. You hear output A: it becomes silent when the signal moves to B.

recordings.title: Trigger level in the app
recordings.description: Trigger level changes from -35 to -80 dBFS at 3.2 seconds. Engages for quieter trigger sound, potentially room noise. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Rewind buffer in the app
recordings.description: Rewind buffer changes from 60 to 10 s at 3.2 seconds. Keeps less history. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Input volume in the app
recordings.description: Input volume changes from 1 to 0 at 3.2 seconds. Lowers it; 0% removes its contribution. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

recordings.title: Noise gate in the app
recordings.description: Noise gate changes from -90 to -20 dBFS at 3.2 seconds. Ignores more room and keyboard noise. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.
